variables.name: BRACES_PATTERN
variables.comment: Warning that \\} can be replaced with } is bogus [internal: b/144480183].

variables.name: POSITION_PATTERN
variables.comment: Matches "\pos(x,y)" and returns "x" in group 1 and "y" in group 2

variables.name: MOVE_PATTERN
variables.comment: Matches "\move(x1,y1,x2,y2[,t1,t2])" and returns "x2" in group 1 and "y2" in group 2

variables.name: ALIGNMENT_OVERRIDE_PATTERN
variables.comment: Matches "\anx" and returns x in group 1

methods.name: private static PointF parsePosition(String styleOverride)
methods.comment:
* Parses the position from a style override, returns null if no position is found. * *

The attribute is expected to be in the form {@code \pos(x,y)} or {@code * \move(x1,y1,x2,y2,startTime,endTime)} (startTime and endTime are optional). In the case of * {@code \move()}, this returns {@code (x2, y2)} (i.e. the end position of the move). * * @param styleOverride The string to parse. * @return The parsed position, or null if no position is found.
